target: Validate a claim about normalization using a normalization ablation. Use a provenance-checked real dataset with consent and access rules.

competency.title: Validate normalization — field data
competency.outcome: Validate a claim about normalization using a normalization ablation. Use a provenance-checked real dataset with consent and access rules.
competency.practice_task: Produce a preregistered test protocol and evidence record grounded in a normalization ablation.
competency.setting_constraint: Use a provenance-checked real dataset with consent and access rules.
required_evidence: a preregistered test protocol and evidence record
Include the data card, missingness check and permitted use.
Report training stability and activation statistics with uncertainty or an explicit deterministic check.
Construct a negative control for the failure mode: mixing training and inference statistics.

assessment.scoring: Each criterion: 0 absent, 1 partial, 2 demonstrated; require 2 on all four.
assessment.threshold_policy: Register the metric threshold, baseline, task budget and evaluator before exposing new items.
criteria: Concept: correctly state the assumptions and limits of normalization.
Practice: a held-out challenge supports or rejects the claim.
Measurement: report training stability and activation statistics against a matched baseline with reproducible inputs.
Critical check: test for mixing training and inference statistics; detect it or rule it out with evidence.

competency.source_policy: Reviewer must add a verified primary source before lesson status; no source is fabricated here.
competency.contamination_policy: No private items, answers, seeds or reviewer-only prompts in this public specification.
